about:
Maysteel Industries, LLC was founded in 1936 in Allenton, Wisconsin. The company began as a metal fabrication shop and has grown into a scalable fabricator for data centers, critical infrastructure, and diversified industrial markets.

The company produces custom enclosures, high-density server racks, aisle containment systems, and prefabricated modular structures for data centers, along with generator enclosures, PDU enclosures, padmount tanks, and transformer enclosures for critical infrastructure. Its vertically integrated model includes direct relationships with steel mills, strategic material inventory, and advanced manufacturing technology such as tube lasers, robotic welding, fiber laser welding, and expanded automation. In-house engineering supports design-for-manufacturing from concept through production.

Maysteel serves data center operators, utility companies, and renewable energy firms, providing OCP-recognized solutions for high-density computing environments, grid resilience equipment, and outdoor enclosures for solar inverters, energy storage, and generators.

The company emphasizes its nearly 90 years of fabrication expertise, engineering-first approach, and investments in automation to control supply, capacity, and lead times for complex, high-volume programs.
